name: DeepSeek 余额
author: Driftlet
description: 自动查询 DeepSeek API 账户余额：展示赠金与充值构成，低余额预警 + Windows 通知，一键打开充值页
description_en: Automatically queries your DeepSeek API account balance: granted/topped-up breakdown, low-balance warning + Windows notification, and one-click top-up page

settings.label: API Key
settings.description: DeepSeek 开放平台的 API Key（platform.deepseek.com → API keys）；仅本机保存，不会注入页面，皮肤经 skin_get_setting 读取
settings.description_en: API key from the DeepSeek platform (platform.deepseek.com → API keys); stored locally only, never baked into the page — the skin reads it via skin_get_setting

settings.label: 自动刷新间隔（分钟）
settings.description: 按此间隔自动重新查询余额；皮肤不可见时暂停查询
settings.description_en: Re-queries the balance on this interval; polling pauses while the skin is not visible

settings.label: 余额预警线
settings.description: 任一币种总余额低于该值时数字标黄、徽标变为「余额不足」；0 = 关闭预警
settings.description_en: When any currency's total balance drops below this value, the figure turns amber and the badge shows 'Low balance'; 0 disables the warning

settings.label: 低余额系统通知
settings.description: 余额跌入预警线以下时发送一次 Windows 通知（不刷屏；余额回升后再次跌入会重新通知）
settings.description_en: Sends one Windows notification when the balance drops below the warning line (no spam; re-arms after the balance recovers)

settings.label: 显示余额构成
settings.description: 在总余额下方显示充值余额（赠金仅在存在时显示）
settings.description_en: Shows the topped-up balance below the total (granted balance appears only when present)

settings.label: 主题色
settings.description: 应用到标志、总余额数字
settings.description_en: Applied to the logo tile and the total balance figure
